subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 映清斋、鉴园
evidence.excerpt_zh: 玉玲瓏館之南為昭曠亭亭東南為映清齋齋東為鑑園敞宇五楹西嚮北為潄瓊齋其東為師善堂（長春園册）臣等謹案鑑園之後有船塢
evidence.summary: South of 玉玲瓏館: 昭曠亭, then 映清齋; east of it 鑑園, a five-bay range facing west, with 潄瓊齋 and 師善堂, and a boathouse behind.

evidence.title: 师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-409
evidence.excerpt_zh: 溪水面前横，堂廉日俯清。万殊参一本，物理即人情。有照原无意，常流故不盈。会心额师善，陈戒缅阿衡。
evidence.summary: Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.113, under 鉴园; source ref 12-669
evidence.excerpt_zh: 书云主善为，易曰元善长。人有能不能，凡善皆宜仿。取诸人为善，重华堪景仰。要复在克己，德量乃能广。五言识所存，协一勉毋两。
evidence.summary: Poem 师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1775, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 题师善堂
evidence.locator: v4 p.108, under 鉴园; source ref 9-422
evidence.excerpt_zh: 力学在择师，宜师莫如善。为之著周誓，积斯训羲典。于从毋畏难，其乐固弗浅。彰里吾应祗，转圜吾应勉。顾名思义多，讵曰兹游衍。
evidence.summary: Poem 题师善堂 by the Qianlong Emperor, 1768, filed by the editors under 鉴园.

evidence.title: 圆明园五朝御制诗文集注 v4, editors' note on 鉴园
evidence.summary: Of 1767, after 趣园 at Yangzhou, on the long lake north-east of 如园. A five-bay open hall faces west; 开益轩 and five-bay 漱琼斋 lie north, 师善堂 east, 芳晖楼 and 绿净榭 south, with a large boat dock behind.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 师善堂.
